written: before running GitTrace or Bandit on this target
sources: README.md is one line ('This is a ZAP Test'); the vulnerabilities are listed from a reading of app/app.py at the pinned commit
the repository's old-workflows/semgrep.yml shows it is used as a SAST/DAST target
notes: /search checks a JWT inside the handler (verify_jwt); in reality it requires authentication, but no decorator or dependency says so.
Out of GitTrace's categories and not listed: SSTI via render_template_string (404 handler, /search error), XXE via python-docx upload, JWT decoded with verify=False, MD5 password hashing.

vulnerabilities.detail: yaml.load(y) on an uploaded file, no Loader
